page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture operates with a single thread per core, providing 32 vCPUs. System memory totals 128.0 GB, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This high-capacity HDD configuration is bundled directly with the instance. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. No graphics processing units (GPUs) are included in this hardware profile.

The hardware profile presents clear architectural tradeoffs. The use of older Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors and mechanical HDD storage instead of solid-state drives (SSDs) limits random input/output operations per second (IOPS) and single-core computational speed. However, this configuration offers high qualitative cost efficiency for scenarios requiring massive sequential storage capacity and high resource density without the premium cost associated with solid-state storage.

This instance type is designed for workloads that require large-scale data storage and sequential processing. Appropriate use cases include distributed file systems, big data analytics, cold data archiving, log processing, and large-scale data warehousing where storage volume is prioritized over low-latency random disk access.
